:::{#exm-binomial-moments}
#### Expected number of responders

In @exm-binomial-sum-bernoulli, $S \sim \dBinf{5, 0.2}$.
By @thm-binomial-moments:

$$
\ba
\E{S} &= 5 \cd 0.2 && \text{(} n\prob \text{)} \\
&= 1 && \text{(multiply)} \\
\Var{S} &= 5 \cd 0.2 \cd (1 - 0.2) && \text{(} n\prob(1 - \prob) \text{)} \\
&= 0.8 && \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$

On average, one of the five patients responds.

:::
